findings.detail: B02 duplicate key is too coarse for BEL USA LLC: source has separate 1st lien term loan lots with different original acquisition dates, par amounts, interest rates, and fair values.

rationale: The raw SOI source shows the named duplicate example as distinct BEL USA LLC loan lots, not repeated records. Rows 2 and 3 share issuer, instrument, industry, rate, and maturity, but row 2 has acquisition date 12/13/2018, par 8,821,421, interest 12.82%, and fair value 1,406,357; row 3 has acquisition date 1/13/2026, par 223,491, interest 12.80, and fair value 223,378. The B02 duplicate-position-key flag therefore appears to collapse legitimate lot-level distinctions.
